For more than 150 years, our brands have created essentials that make life better for billions of people every day. Better Care for a Better World is more than our purpose; it’s how we lead. Through our trusted brands, including Huggies®. Kleenex®. Andrex®. Scott®. Kotex®. Poise®. Depend®, we’re building a future where innovation and sustainability work hand in hand. Our 38,000+ employees around the world share a spirit of invention and responsibility that continues to redefine what care means. We’re proud to be recognized among the world’s top employers and sustainability leaders year after year, but our greatest achievement is our people. Their care moves the world forward. Because when care leads, impact follows. Learn more at kimberly-clark.com. Guided by Chairman and CEO Michael Hsu's vision, we’re reinventing how we innovate and deliver essential products – bringing together better performance, better value, and cost efficiency. We’re delighted to see Natasha Khan and The Wall Street Journal highlight one powerful example of this shift: the work behind our recent Huggies Snug & Dry upgrade – internally called “Buff Baby.” This project began with a bold challenge: make meaningful improvements while delivering strong value. Our teams reexamined everything that went into making the diaper – from materials to manufacturing and more. Innovation, value, and consumer trust are at the core of our Powering Care strategy. “Buff Baby” is one example of how we’re bringing this strategy to life – and of the momentum building across Kimberly‑Clark.
